description: The social-loudness true-peak limiter (ADR-R47, amended 2026-11-08): after the gain, every frame's reduction holds the overshoot of each Annex 2 detection point over the 12 inputs it reads, rises over the 5 ms lookahead before it as a raised cosine, and releases exponentially over 80 ms, ending below 0.01 dB; one reduction for both channels. export cases run the whole rule (measure, plan, simulate and land, export); envelope cases run the limiter alone at gainDb. probes are [frame, reductionDb, left, right] of the output. Floats rounded to 6 decimals; replays compare within 1e-6, samples within 2e-6, limitedFrames within 2.
